"Zero 3E V1.2" is silkscreened on board top between SOC and DRAM. :"radxa" is silkscreened on board bottom.
{{See also|Radxa|List of Single-board computers}}
===Links=== *[https://linuxgizmos.com/updated-radxa-previews-zero-3e-single-board-computer-with-gbe-port/ ''Radxa previews ZERO 3E Single Board Computer with GbE port'' on '''LinuxGizmos'''] *[https://www.cnx-software.com/2024/05/14/radxa-zero-3e-sbc-offers-gigabit-ethernet-and-poe-in-raspberry-pi-zero-2-w-form-factor/ ''Radxa Zero 3E SBC offers gigabit Ethernet and PoE'' on '''CNX|Software''']
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3566 @1.6GHz Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A55) *GPU: ''Mali-G52 2EE'' (OpenGL ES3.2); NPU 0.8Tops @INT8 :VPU (with 4K VP9 and 4K 10-bit H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 2GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *Network: 1x GbE port; GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C OTG), 1x USB 3.0 (Type-C) ports *Power Source: 5V/2A via USB (Type-C OTG) or optional PoE Hat
